name: an unreachable database is an opaque 503 on schema-diff
description: schema-diff must open a connection to walk INFORMATION_SCHEMA, and when it cannot it answers this domain's own ERR_DB_UNREACHABLE at 503 with a generic message. What the fixture really pins is what does not come back: not the host, not the port, not the database name, not a fragment of the SQL, not the password. A caller past the token check still gets no map of the cluster — the failure says only that a configured server is unreachable. A client that needs to know which server reads /readyz or /api/db/servers, which report it in-band.

jsonEquals.error.message: a configured database server is unreachable
